messages:
Arjun Patel: FYI — Customer 'CoreHealth' wants to backfill usage to hit a committed tier for Q2. They signed a 1yr commit but asked to count Jan–Mar retroactively. Is that allowed vs our ratecard v2026? @DealDesk Bot can you confirm process?
Maya Chen: @Arjun Patel we can do a backfill but needs deal-desk approval + revops signoff. We usually treat backfilled usage as "earned" only if there's a signed amendment. :memo:
Jordan Lee: what's the cutoff for automatic grandfathering? do we still honor previous sku tiers if they backfill?
Maya Chen: we don't auto-grandfather. Two paths: 1) amend the PO and apply backdated consumption to the commit (requires legal), or 2) grant a one-time credit (no amendment). Both need deal-desk workflow.
Selina Alvarez: adding context from revops — for commits we require a written amendment that states the effective date. For exceptions under $50k ARR we can approve a credit instead of amendment. Above that, finance + legal must sign.
Arjun Patel: key asks from customer: (a) count Jan–Mar toward their 100k token commit, (b) keep current committed price for rest of year, (c) no changes to billing cycle.
Maya Chen: propose this flow: 1) Sales uploads amendment template + PO, 2) Deal desk reviews pricing impact and approves SLA, 3) Revops issues a backdated invoice/credit memo, 4) Legal attaches amendment to contract. I'll draft the amendment language.
Jordan Lee: estimate of $$ impact? customer expects ~40% uplift in committed usage if we accept backfill. that could move them up one commit tier — need to check revenue recognition implications.
Selina Alvarez: finance flag — if backfill increases committed revenue materially we need COP approval. Please include projected incremental ARR and whether it's one-time or recurring.
Arjun Patel: noted. @Maya can you start the deal-desk ticket? I'll loop in the AE and the customer success manager.
DealDesk Bot: New ticket created: DD-3419. Metadata: impact_estimate=~$18.5k ARR, requires: RevOps approval, Legal amendment. Link: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk/DD-3419 :spiral_note_pad:
Maya Chen: starting ticket now. Quick Q for legal language — do we use "retroactive application" or "amend effective date to Jan 1"? The former reads cleaner for them.
Selina Alvarez: prefer "amend effective date to Jan 1, 2026" — clearer for bookkeeping. Also include clause: "usage applied retroactively requires signed amendment and acknowledgment of billing adjustments."
Jordan Lee: billing ops: pro-rata or one-off invoice? we should prefer a one-off credit memo to avoid mid-cycle invoice churn, unless customer insists.
Maya Chen: agree on credit memo path. I'll note that in the ticket and attach sample credit flow:```
SKU: RED-API-TOKENS
CommitTier: 100k
BackfillMonths: 3
CreditAmount: $18,500
Action: apply as credit on next invoice
```
Arjun Patel: customer also asking about preserving legacy discounting for next 6 months post-amendment. Can we offer that as a limited-time concession?
Maya Chen: concessions can be approved by deal-desk if they're <15% of ARR impact and <6 months. Anything beyond needs revops exec signoff.
Selina Alvarez: to make this smooth — please attach: 1) projected ARR impact, 2) proposed concession %, 3) justification (POC -> upsell), 4) AE & CSM attestation.
Jordan Lee: tagging billing ops for timeline: @billing-ops please confirm lead time for issuing a credit memo and updating committed tier in our billing system.
Arjun Patel: thanks team. I'll ping the AE and customer now, and will update DD-3419 with the signed PO once we have it.
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: will keep this moving.
Selina Alvarez: once legal uploads the amendment, revops will schedule the credit.
Arjun Patel: closing loop — expected next steps: AE to upload signed amendment by EOD Wed, DealDesk -> RevOps for credit, Legal attaches amendment, Billing issues credit next invoice.
Jordan Lee: :eyes: noted. If anything changes about commit tier mapping let us know ASAP so we can pre-flight accounting.
DealDesk Bot: DD-3419 status updated -> awaiting customer PO upload. Reminder set for 48h.
Maya Chen: thanks all. linking internal ratecard note: https://redwood.internal/ratecard/v2026#backfill-guidance
Arjun Patel: cheers — will report back in this thread when PO is in.
